caption:
The video showcases a warehouse sortation line from a stationary viewpoint. A metal roller conveyor runs diagonally across the foreground, while a blue curved turn conveyor, a steel column, railings and shelving stay fixed behind it. A mechanical diverter housing sits at the junction of the two belts. Cardboard boxes already ride the foreground rollers at the start, gliding steadily from left toward right, with more entering from the left edge.

One box advances along the right of the lane for much of the clip, drifting toward the edge without leaving the frame, while a second box crosses the center after entering from the left. A black segmented guide bar shifts its lateral position across the belt, extending over the left of the lane mid-clip before moving right, acting as a diverter rather than cargo.

Near the end a green plastic bin enters from the left edge and travels rightward along the same rollers, reaching the left-center by the final frame. The background structures and diverter housing hold their positions throughout, confirming a stationary camera. The flow of boxes and the bin continues past the last frame without a visible conclusion.
